topics.title: Arrays
topics.description: Learn about the most fundamental data structure - storing elements in contiguous memory
topics.descriptionHi: Sabse basic data structure seekho - elements ko ek saath memory mein store karna

realLifeExample.en: Think of a row of lockers in school - each has a number (index) and holds something inside
realLifeExample.hi: School mein lockers ki ek row socho - har ek ka number (index) hai aur andar kuch rakha hai

topics.title: Strings
topics.description: Master string manipulation, pattern matching, and text processing
topics.descriptionHi: String manipulation, pattern matching, aur text processing seekho

realLifeExample.en: Like a necklace of beads - each bead is a character, and the order matters
realLifeExample.hi: Moti ki mala socho - har moti ek character hai, aur order matter karta hai

topics.title: Linked List
topics.description: Dynamic data structure where elements are connected through pointers
topics.descriptionHi: Dynamic data structure jisme elements pointers se connected hote hain

realLifeExample.en: Like a train - each coach (node) is connected to the next one. You can add/remove coaches easily!
realLifeExample.hi: Train socho - har dabba (node) agle se connected hai. Aasani se dabbe jod ya hata sakte ho!

topics.title: Stack
topics.description: Last In First Out (LIFO) - like a stack of plates
topics.descriptionHi: Last In First Out (LIFO) - plates ke stack jaisa

realLifeExample.en: Stack of plates in a cafeteria - you always take the top plate first (Last In, First Out)
realLifeExample.hi: Canteen mein plates ka stack - hamesha upar wali plate pehle uthate ho (Last In, First Out)

topics.title: Queue
topics.description: First In First Out (FIFO) - like a queue at a ticket counter
topics.descriptionHi: First In First Out (FIFO) - ticket counter pe line jaisi

realLifeExample.en: Queue at a movie ticket counter - first person in line gets served first
realLifeExample.hi: Movie ticket counter pe line - jo pehle aaya wo pehle ticket lega

topics.title: Recursion & Backtracking
topics.description: Solve problems by breaking them into smaller sub-problems
topics.descriptionHi: Problems ko chhote sub-problems mein tod ke solve karo

realLifeExample.en: Like Russian nesting dolls - open one doll, find a smaller one inside, keep going until the smallest
realLifeExample.hi: Russian dolls socho - ek doll kholo, andar chhoti doll milegi, jab tak sabse chhoti na mile

topics.title: Trees
topics.description: Hierarchical data structure - Binary Trees, BST, AVL Trees
topics.descriptionHi: Hierarchical data structure - Binary Trees, BST, AVL Trees

realLifeExample.en: Like a family tree - one ancestor at top, children branch out below
realLifeExample.hi: Family tree socho - ek ancestor upar, uske children neeche branch out hote hain

topics.title: Graphs
topics.description: Network of nodes and edges - BFS, DFS, Shortest Path
topics.descriptionHi: Nodes aur edges ka network - BFS, DFS, Shortest Path

realLifeExample.en: Like a city map - locations are nodes, roads are edges connecting them
realLifeExample.hi: City ka map socho - locations nodes hain, roads edges hain jo unhe connect karti hain

topics.title: Hashing
topics.description: Fast lookup using hash functions - HashMap, HashSet
topics.descriptionHi: Hash functions se fast lookup - HashMap, HashSet

realLifeExample.en: Like a dictionary - you know the word, you directly go to that page. No need to search page by page!
realLifeExample.hi: Dictionary socho - word pata hai, seedha us page pe chale jao. Page by page dhundhne ki zaroorat nahi!

topics.title: Heap
topics.description: Priority-based data structure - Min Heap, Max Heap
topics.descriptionHi: Priority-based data structure - Min Heap, Max Heap

realLifeExample.en: Like a hospital emergency room - most critical patient gets treated first, regardless of arrival order
realLifeExample.hi: Hospital emergency socho - sabse critical patient pehle treat hoga, chahe wo baad mein aaya ho

topics.title: Sorting Algorithms
topics.description: Arrange elements in order - Bubble, Merge, Quick Sort and more
topics.descriptionHi: Elements ko order mein arrange karo - Bubble, Merge, Quick Sort aur bahut kuch

realLifeExample.en: Like arranging books on a shelf by height - you compare and swap until everything is in order
realLifeExample.hi: Books ko height se arrange karna socho - compare karo aur swap karo jab tak sab order mein na ho

topics.title: Searching Algorithms
topics.description: Find elements efficiently - Linear Search, Binary Search
topics.descriptionHi: Elements ko efficiently dhundho - Linear Search, Binary Search

realLifeExample.en: Binary Search is like finding a word in a dictionary - you open the middle, then decide left or right half
realLifeExample.hi: Binary Search dictionary mein word dhundhne jaisa hai - beech mein kholo, phir left ya right half decide karo

topics.title: Dynamic Programming
topics.description: Optimize solutions by storing sub-problem results
topics.descriptionHi: Sub-problem results store karke solutions optimize karo

realLifeExample.en: Like climbing stairs - instead of recalculating ways for each step, remember what you already calculated
realLifeExample.hi: Stairs chadna socho - har step ke liye dubara calculate karne ki jagah, jo pehle calculate kiya wo yaad rakho

topics.title: Greedy Algorithms
topics.description: Make locally optimal choices to find global optimum
topics.descriptionHi: Locally optimal choices karke global optimum dhundho

realLifeExample.en: Like making change with coins - always pick the largest coin first to minimize total coins
realLifeExample.hi: Coins se change dena socho - hamesha sabse bada coin pehle do, total coins kam honge

topics.title: Trie
topics.description: Tree-like structure for storing strings efficiently
topics.descriptionHi: Strings efficiently store karne ke liye tree-like structure

realLifeExample.en: Like phone's autocomplete - as you type each letter, it narrows down suggestions
realLifeExample.hi: Phone ka autocomplete socho - jaise jaise letter type karo, suggestions narrow hoti jaati hain

topics.title: Algorithm Analysis
topics.description: Learn Big-O, Time & Space Complexity
topics.descriptionHi: Big-O, Time & Space Complexity seekho

realLifeExample.en: Like comparing two routes to office - which one is faster? That's what algorithm analysis does for code
realLifeExample.hi: Office ke do raaste compare karna socho - konsa fast hai? Yehi algorithm analysis code ke liye karta hai

topics.title: Divide and Conquer
topics.description: Break problem into smaller parts, solve, then combine
topics.descriptionHi: Problem ko chhote parts mein todo, solve karo, phir combine karo

realLifeExample.en: Like sorting a deck of cards - split into two halves, sort each half, then merge them
realLifeExample.hi: Cards ki deck sort karna socho - do halves mein todo, dono sort karo, phir merge karo

topics.title: Dynamic Programming (DAA)
topics.description: Optimal substructure and overlapping subproblems
topics.descriptionHi: Optimal substructure aur overlapping subproblems

realLifeExample.en: Planning a road trip - calculate shortest path to each city once, reuse for the final route
realLifeExample.hi: Road trip plan karna socho - har city ka shortest path ek baar calculate karo, final route mein reuse karo

topics.title: Greedy Method
topics.description: Always make the locally optimal choice
topics.descriptionHi: Hamesha locally optimal choice karo

realLifeExample.en: Like eating at a buffet - always pick the dish that looks most appealing right now
realLifeExample.hi: Buffet mein khana socho - hamesha wo dish lo jo abhi sabse achhi lag rahi hai

topics.title: Branch and Bound
topics.description: Systematic enumeration with pruning
topics.descriptionHi: Systematic enumeration with pruning

realLifeExample.en: Like solving a maze - explore paths but turn back immediately when you hit a dead end
realLifeExample.hi: Maze solve karna socho - raaste explore karo par dead end mile to turant wapas aa jao

topics.title: Backtracking
topics.description: Try all possibilities, backtrack when stuck
topics.descriptionHi: Sab possibilities try karo, stuck hone pe wapas jao

realLifeExample.en: Like solving a Sudoku puzzle - fill a number, if it doesn't work, erase and try next
realLifeExample.hi: Sudoku solve karna socho - number bharo, agar kaam na kare to mita do aur agla try karo

topics.title: String Matching
topics.description: Efficient pattern searching in text
topics.descriptionHi: Text mein efficiently pattern search karo

realLifeExample.en: Like using Ctrl+F to find a word in a document - but how does the computer actually do it?
realLifeExample.hi: Ctrl+F se document mein word dhundhna socho - par computer actually ye kaise karta hai?

topics.title: NP-Completeness
topics.description: Understanding computational limits
topics.descriptionHi: Computational limits ko samjho

realLifeExample.en: Some puzzles are easy to verify but incredibly hard to solve - that's NP!
realLifeExample.hi: Kuch puzzles verify karna easy hai par solve karna bahut hard - yehi NP hai!
